entry.title: New: Resolution 400 (2024-2026) (Hawaiʻi County) — Adopted
entry.content:
AUTHORIZES THE PAYMENT OF FUNDS OF LATER FISCAL YEARS TO ENTER INTO A MULTI-YEAR LEASE AGREEMENT FOR MAILING SYSTEM EQUIPMENT TO BE USED BY THE OFFICE OF THE COUNTY CLERK

Authorizes the Mayor to enter into a five-year lease agreement with an approximate annual cost of $10,000, to be used by the department’s Support Services Division.
